About

Meet Muhammed Fawas, a Dubai-Based SEO Specialist.

Muhammed Fawas — SEO Specialist, Digital Marketer, Technical SEO Practitioner, Local SEO Strategist, and AI Search Optimization Specialist.

Originally from Kerala and currently based in Dubai, Muhammed Fawas has 2.5+ years of experience in SEO and digital marketing, helping businesses across India and the UAE improve their online visibility, attract qualified organic traffic, and achieve measurable business growth.

His approach to SEO goes beyond traditional keyword rankings. He focuses on building sustainable organic growth through technical excellence, strategic content optimization, search intent, and data-driven decision-making.

With hands-on experience across multiple industries, including e-commerce, healthcare, travel and tourism, consulting, and local businesses, he develops SEO strategies aligned with business objectives and long-term search performance.

His expertise covers Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Local SEO, Keyword Research, Content Strategy, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and AI Search Optimization. He also works with WordPress website development and optimization to build search-friendly digital experiences.

As search continues to evolve with AI-powered platforms and generative search experiences, Muhammed focuses on helping businesses adapt their digital presence for both traditional search engines and emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
